summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG spanning authored levels, player-specific rooms, and shared destinations. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors while place simulations and shared scripts own local worlds, combat, NPCs, loot, UI, avatar presentation, progression, and a shared hinged-door system.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with shops, landmarks, simulated staff/shoppers, arcade games, Glow Up Salon, and one-time visual effects.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates furniture and loot, safe rooms, shifting walls, creature ecology, route guidance, Kade, and Zenith's sealed breach.
places/level01 (3D) - Level 0.1 Zenith Station: station/gallery, doors, breakables, bots/hazards, climate rooms, flight-recorder quest, and drone-refilled posts.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - bedroom character creation/waking space and authored tutorial route with staged encounter and HALOGEN.
places/level1, level2, level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams, and Level 2.1 'Locked'; Dina's camp and M.E.G./B.N.T.G. quests, Refrigerator Paradise operations, and The Edges.

places/level3, gamma, level4, level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office, and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems, Boiler Room rats, library ladders, and framed hotel doors.

places/level6, level7, level10, level11, level12, level26 (3D) - Lights Out, Thalassophobia, Bumper Crop, Infinite City, Matrix, and SS Fun =) liner; Level 11 city/canal, Sedco, script-laid crawl/storeroom and quests; Level 12 is Harris's Matrix room.
places/debug, spamton, bonus and auxiliary configured destinations (3D) - debug mannequin/body gallery, Spamton fight space, shared mall, and authored routes.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, ordered behavior composition, and keyboard/touch action mappings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place settings, authored placements, and local generated/ticked behavior; main and Level 11 sims build and maintain large environments.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene, BODIES toggle, and solo pause time-scale.
places/level1/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/dina-diary.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - Dina camp/diary entry and quest progression; Voss and Cabin 23/Phoebe/stow-nest interactions are in Level 26.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js + scripts/ui.js - camera, third-person toggle, HUD and panels; scripts/loot-ui.js renders HALOGEN inventory, quick slots, and carried tapes.
scripts/quest-marker.js + scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - per-player journal, tracking, objective resolution and markers; folds legacy quest state into shared records.

places/level11/sim.js + scripts/lib/level11-city.js + scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js + scripts/lib/level11-depths.js + scripts/level11-use.js - city/extensions generation, usable props, crawl and Level 11 quest interactions.
places/level12/sim.js + scripts/level12-use.js + scripts/level12-window.js - Matrix room construction and ticking ritual, door/copy-door interactions, and Level 11 window entry.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings, and LEVEL_NAMES used by hub-ui; routing and hub handlers use it.

scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, item descriptions, weapon definitions/rarity and variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js - parametric leaf/frame/sealed-set geometry and eased hinge motion/sounds shared by built doors, home11, Level 2 and Level 5.

scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js + scripts/lib/level11-depths.js + scripts/l11-crawl-geo.js + scripts/lib/data/l11-depths.yml + scripts/lib/data/l11-crawl-kit.yml - Level 11 security gates, crawl geometry/data, rooms, foe roster and storeroom.

scripts/lib/build-piece.js + breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction; built doors use doorPrim and CRT TV builds attach scripts/built-tv.js.

scripts/lib/screen.js - derived read-only screen classifier and wrist gates; scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - quest records/tracking and resolving place/id or coordinate goals; NPC lore/talk data feed talk handlers.
scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/maze0path.js - seeded Level 0 cell/zone/wall/pit/pillar layout and open-point/BFS doorway steering; bounded route cache serves cross-cell creature navigation.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + scripts/lib/data/critter-models.yml, wardrobe*.yml + scripts/lib/critter-model.js + art/human-*/art/body-* - clothing/armor, deterministic looks, human/furry bodies and faces, hair, masks, split garment fitting and restyling.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - baseOf, variantOf, rollVariant, rarityIdx, rarityCap, default.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickSnap, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, fishing handlers, HOLO and holoEnd; also resolves throwable fuse/arm callbacks and blast hits.
scripts/lib/quick-items.js - quickItems, assignQuick; scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.

scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - body/face/head/spec, speciesOf, wardrobe fitting/restyling, anime, FURRY_HEAD (1.2), Dandy morph helpers, STYLE_V (sw61).
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.

scripts/door-geo.js - geometry, collider; scripts/lib/build-piece.js - doorPrim, builtSpec; scripts/lib/door-swing.js - swingTo, sfx; scripts/build-door.js, scripts/home11-door.js, scripts/l2-door.js and scripts/l5-hall-door.js consume the shared hinge motion.

scripts/lib/bonus-extra.js - layBonusExtra; scripts/lib/level11-city.js - layCity, layStreet, tickCity; scripts/l11-streetlamp.js - geometry, collider; scripts/lib/level11-depths.js - layDepths; scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js - layVaults; scripts/l11-crawlers.js and scripts/l11-r55-case.js - update.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, wakeAtSave restoration, heat/cold, carried tapes and playback.

scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - dinaQ, dinaDiary and dcut, and seeds player.state.quests['the-way-back']; scripts/lib/quests.js owns player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; level quest handlers own their per-player quest fields.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, drag/heave/throw session fields and carryMul; held targets own heldBy/down/stagger state.

scripts/lib/loose.js + scripts/lib/breakables.js - loose props own state.loose/mat/hp/maxHp and flight sessions; breakables own wreck transitions and record permanently smashed root objects in place.state.gone for rebuilds.
scripts/lib/knock.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - foe attributes/weight and shared down/stagger knock outcomes; enemy managers retain AI state and write player-targeting sneakTarget.

scripts/lib/quick-items.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.quickSlots maps digit slots to item IDs; assignQuick validates unique carried items and player quick-use executes actions; scripts/lib/feed.js writes player.state.feed/disc.

scripts/l11-crawlers.js - place.state.foes/deadAt/roster track crawl foe IDs, deaths/respawns and roster migration; each foe state holds its kind, HP, home and corpse loot while session memory holds AI/path state.

Door handlers + scripts/lib/door-swing.js - interactors toggle state.open and retain door-specific locks/timers; handlers animate leaf yaw from the stored closed yaw, while the hinge object owns its position and openYaw.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player/foe-steps, swim/climb, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/fights/horde/critter/menu/hub/view3/quest-marker; touch mappings route to the same actions.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes aimPt and ranged aimPitch → player.js ballistics.

scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs; toHub/toSolo perform crossings and track roomHop/save-place state.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done; menu UI renders on menuOpen and solo pause sets place.timeScale.

scripts/main-menu.js BODIES action or debug pad → world.state.bodyStyle (menu also persists player.state.bodyStyle); root sim.js/critter.js select avatar and restyle occupants via critter-model.js; Avatar look/state.wear → critter-model.js and wardrobe fitting.
scripts/lib/hub.js destinations → hub-ui.js and world/player crossings; Bonus Room sim lays NPCs/effects, while hubOffer and mall counters write shop/food state read by handlers and UI.
Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; weapon variants roll through weapons.js.

Player and M.E.G. combat handlers → scripts/lib/body3.js stance/swing/fire/aim/reload → combat-anims.yml; lib/stats.js and ballistics.js apply weapon skill/handling; vmpose renders weapon-specific scope/energy muzzle cues and ballistics renders beam-coloured tracers.

Level 0 main sim → maze.js seeded geometry/cell helpers and level0-moments.js; moments.js handles placed moments; smilers/lurkers use maze0path and sneak.crouchMul while hunter managers publish pursuit cues.

scripts/lib/quests.js writes player.state.quests/qtrack/qdone; level quest handlers and quest-marker.js sync records, resolve goals through quest-mark.js, then draw player-only markers and journal rows; Level 11 usable props dispatch through level11-use.js.

Level 11 sim/city/depths lay generated extensions and crawl props; l11-depths.yml configures the foe roster; l11-crawlers.js tracks place-level lifecycle and AI; R-55 case state is the container reward source and gates later refills.

B-mode and home11 reconstruction → scripts/lib/build-piece.js builtSpec/doorPrim → scripts/door-geo.js leaf geometry + build-door.js; Level 2/Level 5/home11 door placement creates frame and hinged leaf; interact toggles state.open → each door handler calls door-swing.swingTo for eased motion and creak/latch.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/lib/bonus-extra.js + mall-shopper.js/salon-stylist.js/salon-ui.js - authored mall, simulated mall life and one-time neon/fountain lighting effects.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence and rebuild path; CRT TV builds attach screen, sound and glow.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/build-door.js/home11-door.js/l2-door.js/l5-hall-door.js + places/home11/sim.js, places/level2/sim.js, places/level5/sim.js, scripts/l5-hall-lay.js - shared parametric door leaves/frames and eased audio hinge motion, varied by wood/metal/hotel style and opening dimensions.

places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-geo.js + scripts/zenith-breach-geo.js + scripts/zenith-door.js + scripts/zenith-bots.js + scripts/zenith-hatch.js + scripts/zenith-flicker.js + scripts/zenith-drones.js + scripts/zenith-use.js - Zenith Station geometry, doors, hazards, bots and quest interactions.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js + scripts/lib/l4-people.js/level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js/level5-people.yml - authored offices/hotel with role-, look-, dialogue- and schedule-driven residents.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/faces/hair/model/wardrobe data + art/human-cloth/* + art/human-body/* + art/human-head/* + art/body-rig/* + art/body-rebuild/* + art/body-transfer/* + scripts/mat-anime.js - shared human/furry avatar generation, game-rig reshaping and garment fitting/restyling.

scripts/lib/nav.js + scripts/meg-agent.js + scripts/l5-staff.js + scripts/l61-staff.js - independent NPC walkers share exact-endpoint/options-aware, short-lived path cache and query budget; Level 26 quest trail points to Voss.

places/level11/sim.js + scripts/lib/level11-city.js + scripts/lib/level11-vaults.js + scripts/lib/level11-depths.js + scripts/l11-crawlers.js + scripts/l11-globe.js + scripts/l11-shutter.js + scripts/lib/data/l11-depths.yml + scripts/lib/data/l11-crawl-kit.yml - Level 11 city/crawl/vault generation, foe roster and interactive reward/security systems.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Human rig refresh is STYLE_V = sw61; art/body-rig/assets.json pins body and fitted garment outputs. Keep game skeleton/bone names, animation axes, face/head, hands, morph keys and weights when replacing transferred meshes.

art/body-transfer/reshape.py now reshapes the game rig/rest pose to the approved body's joint positions, preserves game bone names/face/morph keys, and writes bones.json plus field.json; downstream garment fitting depends on those outputs.

art/body-transfer/fit.py fits upper garments to the reshaped skin with small positive clearance, smooths deltas across garment edges and preserves loose drape; it applies deltas to all shape keys, so keep garment morph correspondence.

Human wardrobe remains split: humanBody omits Ward_ meshes and wardChildren attaches fitted skinned garment children; body/garment IDs and material slots must stay aligned. Dandy morph targets also need matching garment morphs.

Runtime humanBody keeps Skin_hips visible behind equipped waistbands while Under_bottom stays hidden; Skin_torso_upper_front remains behind collar openings. Preserve these cutout/underwear visibility rules when changing garments.

scripts/door-geo.js pivot contract: leaf feet are the bottom hinge corner and rotation.yaw swings about that point; frame/set origin is the opening centre. Open width is the clear opening; preserve matching hingeSide/swing signs, frame placement and state yaw conventions across migrating doors.
